name: Mercury
description: A cratered world of extremes, racing around the Sun in just 88 Earth days.

name: Venus
description: A bright, cloud-wrapped world with a slow, retrograde rotation.

name: Earth
description: Our ocean-covered home. One orbit defines an Earth year.

name: Mars
description: The rusty red world, with a sidereal day just over 24.6 hours.

name: Jupiter
description: The largest planet: a banded gas giant with a rotation of less than ten hours.

name: Saturn
description: A pale gas giant surrounded by a magnificent system of icy rings.

name: Uranus
description: An ice giant tipped almost onto its side, with a soft cyan atmosphere.

name: Neptune
description: The outermost planet. Its long journey around the Sun takes about 165 Earth years.
